tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs blo 'phel gser gyi phreng mdzes bzhugs so// na mo mañju nā thā ya/ skyabs sems/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i steng du dhīḥyig las 'od 'phros/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ra be/ na mo mañju gho ṣā ya/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs gsum/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang gi snying sgo nga stong pa lta bu'i nang du/ dhīḥyig las 'od 'phros nang gi mun pa dang / tha mal gyi lus bsregs sbyangs oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsar+b+ba dhar+m+ma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ aḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dhīḥyig gser btso ma'i mdog can/ de las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba la bkod/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mkhyen rab byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas/ rang gi sems dhīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mi shes pa gcod par byed pa'i shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung nas/ snyan gyi thad sor kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa'i nyams can/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten pa/ 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i steng du shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa ser po/

lte bar g.yas su dhīḥ g.yon du a/ rtsibs la mdun nas g.yas skor du/ ra/ pa/ tsa/ na/ gnas pa/ dhīḥlas 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi snying kha'i shes rab kyi 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib las ngan gti mug gi dri ma sbyangs te/ 'jam dpal gyi skur gyur/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad sngags phreng dang 'od zer ser po'i rnam par byung shes rab kyi 'khor lo'i yig 'bru rnams la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ ci mang bzlas/ rang gi lce'i steng du dhī dmar ser mgo gre phugs su bstan nas/ nyal stabs su gnas pa las 'od 'phros rang gi ngag gi nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs par bsam ste/ dbugs thengs gcig la dhīḥthon tshad brjod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī sa pa ri wā ra ār+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ gang gi blo gros sgrib gnyis sprin bral nyi ltar rnam dag rab gsal ba'i/ /ji snyed don kun ji bzhin gzigs phyir nyid kyi thugs kar glegs bam 'dzin/ /gang dag srid pa'i brtson rar ma rig mun 'thims sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i/ /'gro tshogs kun la bu gcig ltar brtse yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsung /

/'brug ltar cher sgrog nyon mongs gnyid slong las kyi lcags sgrog 'grol mdzad cing / /ma rig mun sel sdug bsngal myu gu ji snyed gcod mdzad ral gri bsnams/ /gdod nas dag cing sa bcu'i mthar son yon tan lus rdzogs rgyal sras thu bo'i sku/ /bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan spras bdag blo'i mun sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ /gang tshe blta bar 'dod pa'am/ /cung zad dri bar 'dod na yang / /mgon po 'jam dbyangs khyed nyid ni/ /gegs med par ni mthong bar shog /brtse ldan khyed kyi mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis/ /bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas/ /bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs rtogs pa yi/ /blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba bstsal du gsol/ /shes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa/ /'khor ba myang 'das gnyis med pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /phyi ma byang chub ma thob bar/ /bcom ldan 'jam dbyangs khyed nyid kyis/ /bdag gi bla ma mdzad du gsol/ /gang gi mkhyen rab nyi ma stong bas kyang / /ches cher gsal bas 'gro ba'i ma rig pa/ /drung nas 'byin mdzad lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bdag gi snying la rgyun du 'jug gyur cig /gdong bzhi gdong gi pad tshal gyi/ /ngang pa'i bu mo thams cad dkar/ /dbyangs can ma de'ang kho bo yi/ /yid la ring du rol bar mdzod/ /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /swa nāp+tā wā gen+d+ra s+yār+the ṣu bhū mi paṇ+ḍu ka lo tsa li khyātra/ /rang gi tsha bo ngag gi dbang po'i don du sa skya lo rtsa bas bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
